'''Silya Shessaun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Thesme]] who represented the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Coming from a working-class family, she was one of the few non-upper class citizens of Thesme able to make a name for herself in the political arena. Due to her origins, Shessaun consistently championed the causes of the poor and underprivileged. During her time as a [[Senator/Legends|Galactic Senator]], she often confided in her close friend, fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. Shessaun received only minor criticism in her tenure, since she seemed to focus on her sector as a whole more than her native Thesme.

Shessaun was forced back to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] when the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] threatened it circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Amidala asked her to join the [[Delegation of 2000]], but the Thesme native believed that such actions were little better than those of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] rose in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and Amidala apparently died during the "[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|uprising]]," Shessaun launched an inquest into her friend's death, but the now-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] barred it. She was later asked to step down as Senator due to her lack of enthusiasm for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and lived out her early retirement on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Shessaun would later return to her native Thesme, where she peacefully died in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Silya Shessaun was born on [[Thesme]] into a working-class family. She was considered a child prodigy, and was thrust into the political arena at an early age. She set about championing the causes of the poor and underprivileged in her work, which would carry on into her later career. When she became an [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]], she traveled to a summit on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where she met [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The two were paired off during a week-long workshop, with the older Shessaun taking the role of the mentor. The Thesme native was impressed with the young girl from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and the two became friends. They remained in correspondence with one another after the summit, and Shessaun was pleased to hear that Amidala became the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo.<ref name="db" />

===Galactic Senator===
At the age of twenty, Shessaun became Thesme's [[Senator/Legends|Galactic Senator]], the first of her [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] working-class to do so. She carried her humble demeanor into office, where she would become a key figure in several social programs [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide. She did receive some criticism from those who felt she focused too much on the galaxy at large, rather than her native Thesme. Her friend Amidala would also join the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senatorial]] ranks in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], and the two would confer on issues constantly.<ref name="db" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Shessaun was called back to her homeworld to mediate a variety of territorial disputes. Several worlds under her jurisdiction in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] threatened to secede and join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but Shessaun had no intention of losing them, so she treated each dispute personally. She was one of the most vocal members of [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] senators outside [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], due to spending a great deal of time away from the capital during the conflict, but she missed the luxury of being able to discuss issues with Amidala. Despite this, Shessaun refused to join the [[Delegation of 2000]], feeling that any effort to undermine [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would be tantamount to a Separatist act.<ref name="db" />

===The New Order and Rebellion===
When the Clone Wars came to a close in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Shessaun heard that her good friend Amidala had perished in the so-called "[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rebellion." Shessaun was skeptical as to the circumstances of her friend's death, but she attended the funeral on Naboo nonetheless. Returning to Coruscant, she attempted to launch a Senate inquest into the death, but her attempts were blocked by the now-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, who cited "security concerns."<ref name="db" />

Shessaun was now convinced that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was a corrupt beast, but she kept her sympathies for the growing rebellion movements a secret. Despite her best efforts to distance herself from the Delegation of 2,000 and other rebellious groups, her previous ties to Amidala and the more vocally anti-Palpatine Senators prompted her more pro-Imperial colleagues to force her out of office. She was never specifically targeted as some of her fellow Senators were, but she was nonetheless replaced by a representative more amiable to the Empire.<ref name="db" />

Moving to Alderaan, Shessaun spent her early retirement secretly aiding [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Alderaanian Resistance|rebellion movement]]. She aided Organa in raising his adopted daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], not knowing that the young girl was actually the daughter of her late friend, Amidala. Eventually, Shessaun moved back to Thesme. There, on her homeworld, she died peacefully amongst her loved ones, including Leia Organa, shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Silya Shessaun, having been born into a working-class family, had lived the life of the underprivileged, and decided to aid them once she had the requisite power. She would consistently champion the cause of the underdog, as she had been in their position before. Despite this, she understood how dangerous speaking out publicly against oppressive rulers was, and she chose not to openly defy Palpatine during the Clone Wars. She soon learned the error of her ways, but was still unable to act while in office, leading her to have to sacrifice her post in order to aid Organa's rebellious efforts. Her devotion to the working-class gained her a small set of detractors during her tenure as Senator, as she seemed to spend less time on Thesme than some of its inhabitants might have wanted. It took the threat of secession to draw her back, almost permanently. The talents that had gained her the status of "prodigy" and had allowed her to become a Senator in the first place allowed her to stave off any prospective secessionist movements in the Thesme sector.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silya Shessaun was portrayed by [[Lisa Shaunessy]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], but was cut from the film. The name "Silya Shessaun" is derived from an anagram of the name "Lisa Shaunessy." The backstory for Shessaun's character was developed by [[Nathan Hathaway Adams]] (under the alias "Twi'LekEntertainer"), through [[StarWars.com]]'s "[[What's The Story?]]" feature. Adams' entry was elaborated on by [[Evan Burger]] (under the alias "ShadowCultist"), "[[Master Starkeiller]]" and [[Greg Mitchell]] (under the alias "HedecGa"). Mitchell's addition focused on her refusal to join the Delegation of 2,000, though the elements added by "Master Starkeiller" and Burger are unknown.<ref name="blog">{{Blog|hedecga|5|Silya Shessaun: In-Depth}}</ref>
